scenarios.label: fifo_groups_order

delivery_polling_result.condition: runtime IDs plus approximate empty queue

scenarios.order_scope: Per-group observed runtime record order; no assertion of total order across groups.

findings.label: runtime_record_shape
findings.finding: Native SQS records include messageId, receiptHandle, body, attributes, messageAttributes, md5OfBody, md5OfMessageAttributes, eventSource, eventSourceARN, awsRegion. Number 0012.3400 becomes stringValue 12.34; Binary bytes 00 01 7f 80 ff become binaryValue AAF/gP8=. Each message attribute has empty stringListValues and binaryListValues; inapplicable scalar value key is absent.

findings.label: success_and_disable
findings.finding: Three exact seeded IDs remained while Disabled and invoked after enable with no further sends; successful execution followed by three empty post-disable long polls.

findings.label: ordinary_error
findings.finding: All three exact IDs invoked at receive count1 with thrown handler error, then at count2 with success; queue empty after disable.

findings.label: partial_disabled
findings.finding: Returning an exact failed ID while FunctionResponseTypes=[] acknowledged all three messages; no retry, empty post-disable queue.

findings.label: partial_enabled_isolated
findings.finding: Mapping created with ReportBatchItemFailures received three IDs, returned one exact failed ID from a two-record batch, and retried only that ID at count2. Metrics Polled4, Invoked4, FailedInvoke1, Deleted3 corroborate.

findings.label: malformed_reports
findings.finding: Unknown all-zero message UUID, empty-string itemIdentifier, numeric itemIdentifier, and nonarray batchItemFailures each caused native retries at receive count2. The distinct response {batchItemFailures:[{}]} yielded no retry and empty post-disable queue in this bounded run; do not conflate omitted key with empty string.

findings.label: filter_disposal_isolated
findings.finding: Mapping created with body.kind=[keep] invoked only matching JSON ID; nonmatching JSON and malformed JSON IDs were absent from runtime and all three post-disable long polls. EventCount Polled3/FilteredOut2/Invoked1/Deleted3 establishes disposal, not merely bounded no-delivery.

findings.label: fifo
findings.finding: Six exact messages in groups A and B preserved per-group runtime index order A:[0,1,2], B:[3,4,5]. Native group/dedup/sequence attributes match sends; no cross-group total order assertion.

findings.label: batch_controls
findings.finding: Clean created mappings observed standard size3/window1 batches [2,1] and standard size2/window0 batches without exceeding size2. FIFO size2/window0 delivered [2,2,1,1]. Timing and batch filling are not exact guarantees.

findings.label: propagation_sensitive_updates
findings.finding: Primary partial_enabled, filter_json_and_malformed, batch_window_zero change existing settings then send immediately: runtime behavior did not match newly returned settings (failed partial ID acknowledged; newly filtered messages invoked; after filter removal only matching ID invoked). These are propagation-sensitive observations, not stable partial/filter/window fixtures. Isolated create-time supplements provide stable behavior.

findings.label: ordinary_audit
findings.finding: Ten exact ESM runtime request IDs join CloudTrail Invoke Data records. AWSService identity invokedBy lambda.amazonaws.com; requestParameters sourceArn is ESM ARN, not SQS ARN; invocationType RequestResponse, logType None, contentType application/json, sourceAccount account. responseElements null. Direct Invoke control succeeded but its audit record did not arrive in the bounded capture.

findings.label: metrics
findings.finding: Native ESM EventCount metrics use only EventSourceMappingUUID dimension. Corrected bounded read shows Lambda Invocations40, Errors2, Throttles0, matching 39 SQS ESM calls and one direct control. Absent datapoints remain empty, not zero.
